errors.evidence: The chart displays data for six banks, but the description mentions only five, completely omitting "Д Банк" (D Bank).
In the description of the blue line ("ЦКБ"), it claims the value drops to around 50% in 2009, but the chart shows the value is actually around 70% at that time.
In the description of the blue line ("ЦКБ"), it states that the value decreases slightly until 2013 after a rise in 2011. However, the chart shows that the line continues to rise from 2011 to 2014.
In the description of the dark grey line ("Общинска банка"), the peak of ~100% is said to be in 2009, but the chart clearly shows this peak occurs in 2010.
In the description of the dark grey line ("Общинска банка"), it claims the value drops to 40% in 2015. The chart shows this line never drops below approximately 55%.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the light grey line ("Интернешънъл Асет Банк") starts at around 50%. The chart shows it starts at approximately 90%.

The description identifies the line for "Общинска банка" as dark grey ("тъмносива"). While there are two grey lines, this specific line is lighter than the one for "Интернешънъл Асет Банк", making the color description potentially confusing. A better description would distinguish between the two shades of grey more clearly.
The description identifies the line for "Интернешънъл Асет Банк" as light grey ("светлосива"). This line is actually a darker grey than the line for "Общинска банка", creating a color mapping error.
